description: Lists the ready-made project templates (website launch, event, office move, marketing campaign, software sprint, ERP/CRM rollout, wedding, thesis...) and the templates saved by the user: id, name, number of tasks and typical duration. The templateId is the input of planitude_create_project_from_template. Read-only.

locale.description: Language of template and task names. Default en.

name: planitude_list_templates
title: List project templates
